summary: The Budget Committee will consider and make recommendations to the Mayor and City Council on the 2023 Capital and Operating Budgets. decided: The Budget Committee recommended that the Mayor: 1. Propose a Budget to City Council based on a property tax rate increase on 5.5 percent. 2. Propose a Capital Budget and plan to City Council based on a 10 year extension of the City Building Levy. 3. Continue to work with City Officials to find opportunities for further offsets and savings, and that any such savings be re-allocated as increases to budgets for City priorities including community safety and wellbeing, housing, public realm and natural infrastructure, community grants and programs, and investments in Neighbourhood Improvement Areas, in the Mayor's proposed Budget. 4. Propose a budget for the Toronto Police Service that is consistent with the budget approved by the Toronto Police Services Board, with the exception of the portion in which the Mayor has declared an interest. 5. Continue to work with Toronto Transit Commission Officials to look for opportunities to improve safety and service, and to include any additional proposals that improve safety and service on the Toronto Transit Commission, in the Mayor's Budget proposal to City Council. 6. Propose a budget for housing-related programs, totaling $615.8 million in net operating budget funding (excluding COVID-19 costs) for the Housing Secretariat, Shelter, Support and Housing Administration, and Toronto Community Housing Corporation / Toronto Senior Housing…
